summary: Complete contiguous row partitions repeat the full CSR arithmetic for the CLI-requested count. Restrict-qualified arguments have not collapsed the iterations in the inspected executable.

source_evidence.claim: The balanced row boundaries are monotone from zero through numRows, and chunked transfers retain all values and columns. Timed local products run unconditionally for every requested iteration, independently of the reference.

compiled_evidence.claim: Both root and worker clock branches enter the same arithmetic region. vmulsd/vaddsd a65d/a666 is inside entry a66d, row a67c and repetition a688->a610 loops, including the empty-row path.
